outputs: generated text sequences for language modeling and commonsense reasoning tasks
The model generates text in an autoregressive manner during language modeling and zero-shot/few-shot reasoning tasks.

changes_made.explanation: Added 'Other:Commonsense Reasoning' task since the paper evaluates on commonsense reasoning benchmarks. Normalized dataset name capitalization.
Removed redundant metric variants ('PPL' is normalized to 'Perplexity', 'zero-shot accuracy' and 'few-shot accuracy' are variants of 'Accuracy'). Kept base metrics only.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on improving Gated Linear Attention mechanisms for efficient language modeling. The NLG evaluation is primarily through autoregressive language modeling tasks using perplexity and accuracy metrics on commonsense reasoning benchmarks. The paper does not conduct human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed minor normalization and one task addition.
